title: lobster.result/1
description: Outcome of one completed run. Emitted in run_state completed (stdio) and by RunManager.get().

provider.description: The LLM provider the run used, as the engine resolved it for the run's session (MCP runs from this build on; every turn of a session names its first run's). Absent for a replayed model or when it could not be read.

model.description: The model the run used for that provider, unless the provider file names another model for one expert. Absent as provider is, or when the provider names no default.

notes.description: MCP runs: the end of the supervisor text that came before the final answer (at most 4,000 characters, from a line start, after a line saying earlier text was left out), or of all of it when the model sent no final answer (see the no_final_answer warning). It is commentary between steps, not a result, and can disagree with metrics.

notes_chars.description: MCP runs: how many characters the supervisor text behind notes had before it was cut. Present whenever notes is.

previous_workspace_moved_to.description: MCP runs: where the session folder of an earlier run in this output_dir that never finished was moved, whole, before this run began. Nothing in it was deleted; the user may delete it.

plan.description: MCP first turns: requested is lobster_run plan; asked is true when the turn's first question came before any expert started, the plan's approval.

token_usage.description: Token and cost figures. Cost is the list value of the tokens; cached input is priced at the full input rate. The run_* keys (run_cost_usd, run_total_tokens, run_cost_complete, run_unpriced_invocations, run_missing_usage_invocations) cover this run only and are absent when the run could not be costed. run_cost_complete false means at least one call was unpriced or reported no usage, so the figure is a lower bound. latest_cost_usd is the cost of the last model call, not of the run; session_total_usd is the whole session.

modality_details.description: One object per modality in memory at the end of the run (MCP runs); modalities keeps the names.

file.description: Path of the saved .h5ad file, when the modality was saved.

request.description: What the host asked for (MCP runs).

question.description: The host's question of a lobster_run as normalised (MCP runs from this build on).

experts.description: The experts the host named for the run (lobster_run experts); every turn of the session keeps them. Absent: the project's experts.

plan.description: lobster_run plan: whether the host asked the first turn to plan before any expert works (MCP runs from this build on).

analysis.description: The fixed analysis of a run made by an earlier build; absent in question runs.

input_path.description: The file the host named, when it named one.

instruction.description: The host's free-text instruction as normalised, or null.

channel.description: mcp:<host name>, as the host reported it.

turn.description: The turn this result belongs to, from 1; a continued run is turn 2 or later.

model_source.description: replay when the model was a scripted replay file, not a provider; absent otherwise.

unfinished_instructions.description: Instructions of the turns just before this one that were cancelled or failed, oldest first; absent when there are none.

steps_completed.description: Tools whose steps completed before the turn stopped. The session keeps their results until the server stops; data they made that was never saved to a file is not kept across a restart. Absent when none did.

unfinished_instructions_total.description: How many there were, when the list is cut to the newest.

not_restored.description: The first turn after a restart only: modalities earlier turns made that were never saved and so are not in the restored session (see the modalities_not_restored warning). At most 10 names.

not_restored_total.description: How many there were, when the list is cut.

loaded_files.description: Files the turn read with a loading tool, as resolved paths and the modality each became; at most 20.

loaded_files_total.description: How many files were loaded, when loaded_files is cut.

decisions.description: Answers a host gave to questions asked during this turn, in the order given, as the host reported them; absent when none was asked.

question.description: The question as it was shown, cut when long.

answer.description: The accepted answer in its recorded form.

source.description: human or model, as the host reported it.

channel.description: mcp:<host name>, as the host reported it.

decisions_total.description: How many answers were given, when decisions lists only the first of them.

continued_from.description: The run this one continues, null or absent for a first run.

metrics.description: Numbers read from the session after the run, never from model text. Each part is absent when it could not be read (see the metrics_unavailable warning).

thresholds_assessed.description: uns qc_thresholds by name, as the assessment recorded them; null when not recorded.

thresholds_applied.description: The last filter_and_normalize parameters (min_genes_per_cell, max_genes_per_cell, max_mito_percent, max_ribo_percent); null for a threshold not applied.

flagged_kept.description: Cells with qc_pass False in the final data; null without a qc_pass column.

scope.description: The figures are those of this turn; the session's totals are in token_usage.

steps.description: The analysis steps recorded during this run (provenance activities), parameter values cut to 200 characters; at most 50, see steps_total.

steps_total.description: Number of steps recorded when steps was cut.

warnings.description: Facts about the run worth a second look, from a closed list of codes; messages are built from the numbers.

files_written.description: Files on disk written since the run started (an mtime scan of the workspace data, exports and plots folders); null when the workspace could not be read, see files_written_error. Absent when the session has no file source.

format.description: File format of a published view, such as html.

title.description: A label for a published plot view.

plots_truncated.description: True when more figures were drawn than got an HTML view; see plots_total.

plots_total.description: Number of figures committed in the turn when plots_truncated.

files_written_error.description: Why files_written is null: a short reason code, never a path or message.
